requirements.text: The library management system shall ensure comprehensive data protection by enforcing encryption for all member data and compliance with regulations.
The library management system shall provide a unified mechanism for notifying members of overdue books to enhance accountability and operational efficiency.
The library management system shall maintain a maximum borrowing limit of 5 books while allowing predefined exceptions at librarian discretion.
The library management system shall prioritize the acquisition of e-books to reduce physical resource consumption.
The library management system shall implement energy-efficient infrastructure to minimize energy consumption and report energy usage quarterly.
The library management system shall enable real-time tracking of book inventory to prevent double borrowing.
The library management system shall securely log all transaction activities for auditability and accountability purposes.
The library management system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The library management system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues regarding library services.
